title: Idleness is Relative: Exploiting Tool-Call Idle Windows for Offloading in Agentic Systems with MORI
summary_zh: MORI 將 agent program 的閒置程度建模為連續且相對的排序，依最近五個 inference–tool 週期將 KV cache 動態配置於 GPU HBM、CPU DRAM 與 Waiting tier。在 80 個並行 program 下，相較最佳 offloading baseline，輸出 throughput 提升 20–71%、TTFT 降低 18–43%。
summary_en: MORI models each agent program's idleness as a continuous, relative ranking, then places KV cache across GPU HBM, CPU DRAM, and a Waiting tier using the five most recent inference–tool cycles. At 80 concurrent programs, it improves output throughput by 20–71% and lowers TTFT by 18–43% over the strongest offloading baseline.
